notes.title: New trailer for PRAGMATA!
notes.notes:
Check out the latest trailer for Pragmata shown at Tokyo Game Show with new details on the gameplay loop!

[previewyoutube=ysJ9Cb1WXsk;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover the Shelter that serves as Hugh and Diana's base of operations. Make preparations here before exploring each stage and return here to recover health. You can also upgrade Hugh's weapons using materials collected while exploring and in battle. 

Learn how Hugh and Diana combine their skills in combat. Hack enemies with Diana and pass through hacking nodes to activate various effects, and take them down with Hugh's arsenal of weapons. Pierce through enemies in single blow with the Charge Piercer. Distract enemies with decoys by using the Decoy Generator. Hack multiple enemies in one go with Multihack.

This fusion of hacking and shooting delivers an immersive fast-paced strategic gameplay where every decision shapes the battle.

notes.title: The Future Games Show at gamescom 2025: Everything Announced!
notes.notes:

The biggest gaming event of the year kicked off yesterday with the gamescom ONL 2025 showcase. As fast as gamescom 2025 entered the scene with Opening Night Live 2025, reveals and showcases have followed and are currently dominating the internet, giving players a good look at what’s to come for the next year in gaming and beyond.

Outside of the already exciting announcements of Kirby Air Riders Nintendo Direct, and fresh looks being shown of World of Warcraft: Midnight alongside Resident Evil: Requiem, there’s a reason for gamers of all genres to be excited. Gamescom ONL 2025 has brought the goods in the form of many trailers, and today’s Future Games Show 2025 is no different. notes.title: More details revealed for this unique sci-fi action adventure!
notes.notes:
Check out the latest news revealed during the recent Capcom Spotlight stream! This sci-fi action adventure combines puzzles and action with an engaging story which starts with an encounter between space-suited protagonist Hugh and the android girl Diana, who join forces to escape a lunar facility. Watch the Capcom Spotlight segment to find out more!

[previewyoutube=omnl-EMxfYE;full][/previewyoutube]

Unique Hacking Action Combat
Diana hacks enemies while Hugh uses a variety of weapons to take them down. This blend of hacking and action demands quick thinking and multitasking, with a unique catharsis unlike anything you've played before.

It Takes Two
Hugh and Diana must co-operate outside combat as well to traverse the lunar facility they find themselves in. Use the thrusters in Hugh's space suit to fly around, then use Diana's hacking ability to open new paths and unlock the way forward.

First Public Hands-on At Gamescom 2025
Pragmata will be available for public hands-on for the first time at the gamescom 2025 event in Cologne, Germany from Wednesday August 20! The game will make appearances at other game shows around the world as well, so follow our official channels and stay tuned for more news in the coming months.

Full Website Now Open
The teaser site for the game has been expanded into a full site where you can find even more details on the unique combat system, and even try out an interactive preview of the hacking minigame. Check it out for just a taste of what Pragmata will offer.

https://www.capcom-games.com/pragmata/

notes.title: Pragmata Preview: Yes, it Exists, and Yes, It’s Kind of Great
notes.notes:
First announced back in 2020, news around Pragmata had been very limited—until it made its presence known at Summer Game Fest 2025 and gave the press some hands-on time with the title. What initially looked like an interesting concept has finally manifested into something intriguing, unique and potentially very exciting. While I was initially skeptical about what Pragmata could be and how it might work in practice, at least based on my 20 minutes with the title, I’m excited to see more and experience what the game has to offer when it launches in 2026.

While the game has been somewhat shrouded in mystery, this year we’ve gotten a bit more detail about what’s going on and what makes the setting so compelling. Waking up after some sort of incident, you take control of Hugh Williams, who finds himself with no idea what’s happening—or why everything seems determined to kill him.
